item.name: Sync payment from Stripe (if webhook not running)

request.description: Without a valid Stripe-Signature the API correctly answers 400.
Revoke the current session: its access and refresh tokens stop working.

Full checkout preview using current server-side prices, promotions,
coupon, tax and shipping rules. Nothing is changed or reserved.
Only the signed-in user's own profile is ever returned here.

Product/inventory, order, revenue, payment, low-stock and return
summaries. Each role only receives the sections it is allowed to see.
Send queued deliveries and retry eligible failures (with backoff).

Stripe → server callback. Signature is verified before anything runs;
replays of the same event id are acknowledged and ignored.

Ask Stripe directly for the session state (useful when webhooks cannot
reach a local machine). Uses the same idempotent code path as the webhook.
Create a product. Only authorized catalog managers may do this.
List active products with optional search and filters.
Retrieve one active product by its ID.
Update product fields without replacing unspecified values.
Soft-deactivate a product instead of permanently deleting it.
Send an APPROVED refund to the payment gateway (idempotent).
Generate a report file in the background; poll /jobs/{id}.
Process queued email/SMS deliveries (and retry eligible failures).
Schedule a recurring inventory/order/etc. summary export.

Run one scheduler pass now (use from cron when the in-process
scheduler is disabled).
Download a report immediately as csv, xlsx or pdf.
Reports the current user may run.

Sales, orders, inventory, payments, refunds, returns and product /
category performance reports with date, status, category and warehouse
filters. See GET /reports/catalog for the list.
